title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving, the one 2026 session where the cash bond tape outlives the equity tape
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-09 by the thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26 initial research (HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload, because the rendered page hides the non-default year tabs. The 2026 US Thanksgiving card renders as three fields: heading 'Thanksgiving Day', date 'Thursday, November 26, 2026', note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 27, 2026'. PANEL ATTRIBUTION VERIFIED FIRST-HAND rather than assumed: the card immediately preceding it in the same payload run is 'Veterans Day / Wednesday, November 11, 2026' and the one following is 'Christmas Day / Friday, December 25, 2026' with its own 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 24, 2026' note — a US-only sequence quoting Eastern Time, where the same page's Japan panel carries 'Labour Thanksgiving Day / Monday, November 23, 2026' and its 2027 cards each add 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan'. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the fourth Thursday in November, November 2026's Thursdays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th, so the day after the fourth is Friday 2026-11-27. Filed estimate on the same three counts every sibling SIFMA entry documents: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's closes are recommendations subject to change rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26 initial research (2026-09-09). THIS IS AN EXPLICIT HAND-OFF, NOT A FRESH DISCOVERY: the proposal that seeded this proposer's own id (proposals/thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26.from-christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25.json) named this entry in its closing paragraph — 'SIFMA also recommends a 2:00 p.m. ET US fixed-income early close on Friday 2026-11-27 against NYSE's 1:00 p.m. equity close ... It is left unfiled because it is two steps outside this proposer's corridor, not because it is doubtful.' It is one step inside this proposer's corridor: 2026-11-27 is the session immediately after the closure this lane owns, and reading the closure meant holding the same SIFMA panel open. WHY IT IS NOT A DUPLICATE OF thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, which is canonical on the same date: the two markets keep DIFFERENT hours on this session and in the unusual direction. NYSE footnote *** (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-fetched 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes) puts equities out at 13:00 ET and eligible options at 13:15; SIFMA recommends fixed income out at 14:00 ET. The precedent for a separate row is settled and symmetric: sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26 is canonical on the 2027 Thanksgiving Friday alongside thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26, and this calendar carries 2026-12-31, 2027-03-25 and 2027-05-28 on the same pattern. The 2026 gap was a hole, not a decision — this is the only US early close in the 2026 SIFMA panel with no matching entry. NARROWING CARRIED FORWARD from sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26's own initial research, so this row does not re-import a claim already corrected: it is NOT true that from 13:00 to 14:00 ET the Treasury tape is the only US price discovery running, because the same NYSE footnote continues 'NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m.' What ends at 13:00 is the CORE session and the closing auction, so the accurate fact is that every listed bond proxy prints its official close an hour before the cash tape it tracks stops trading. THE ISSUER'S OWN TREATMENT, from a primary depending on neither holiday calendar: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query (fetched 2026-09-09, 6,023 auctions since 2009) returns ZERO auctions dated on the day after Thanksgiving in every year of the series, consistent with SIFMA's verbatim note that early-close recommendations do not affect settlement times. Kind 'rates', impact low, symbols [] and status estimate copy sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26 exactly and invent no new kind; EventKind in src/domain/market-events-types.ts still has no market-structure member, which is the honest reason 'rates' is the closest fit. NOT PROPOSED alongside it, and named here so the next sweep does not re-derive it: Treasury's 4-Week and 8-Week bill slate is displaced from Thanksgiving Thursday to the Wednesday before in 7 of 7 years since 2019 (see the proposer's ledger, leg 5), which would be a Wednesday 2026-11-25 bill-auction row. It is left unfiled because this calendar tracks coupon auctions and carries no bill-auction entry of any kind, so filing one is a schema decision this lane declines to take in passing.
